title: Project directory got a cleanup pass
summary:
A quiet garden day: cleaner project listings, refreshed docs, and a little repository maintenance.

The community project listings were reorganized and refreshed, including updated README and PROJECTS.md tables. The toai.chat entry also dropped an invalid URL field, so the directory points people at projects with less archaeological ambiguity.

A follow-up housekeeping pass landed alongside the directory work, keeping the repository's accumulated edges from becoming permanent architecture.
